hypothesis: OBV net flow over 5, 10 or 20 completed signal bars may confirm fixed Dual ZigZag + daily SMA20 entries and reject more eventual losing than winning trades. Measure changes in PnL, monthly outcomes and risk; standalone OBV-crossing is an ablation.

research_provenance.implementation: adaptation: OBV flow as third indicator; Trendoscope shows OBV as possible external series but does not specify this trade rule

required_data: completed 60-minute OHLCV candles with observed nonnegative volume
daily SMA20 aggregated from signal bars
availability_lag: All OBV inputs are completed signal bars, including the current signal close/volume; entry at next open. SMA uses prior completed days only.
signal_semantics: Per-stock long/short signal from closed 1H or 4H bar; next open execution; no historical pivot-marker entry.
evaluation_unit: Independent per-stock experimental account; one common parameter setting chosen by early ranking for paper review.

mechanisms: parent entry confirmed by same-sign OBV delta
entry_design.confirmation: OBV[i] - OBV[i-L] is positive for long, negative for short; L=5,10,20 completed bars
entry_design.common_exit_rule: parent raw opposite event for combined variant; OBV opposite crossing for standalone
not_applicable: using plotted OBV pivot before confirmation
new stop/target in this indicator-addition test

untested_dependencies: independent tuning of original price/RSI/SMA parameters

parameter_rationale: OBV flow over 5, 10 and 20 completed 1H/4H bars spans short to medium confirmation. Frozen before reading this experiment PnL. Parent parameters and exits are not retuned.
baseline: One 25% long buy-and-hold position on same stock/timeframe. `parent` is the fixed 4H SMA20 strategy applied to both declared intervals.
signal_rule: OBV begins at zero and adds volume when close rises versus previous completed signal bar, subtracts when it falls, holds otherwise. Standalone entry occurs when L-bar OBV delta crosses zero. Combined entry preserves the parent event only if its sign agrees with current L-bar OBV delta. All parent raw opposite exits remain, even when the opposite entry is rejected. Fill next open.
execution_timing: Decision on completed bar; fill next open; 25% of equity per position.
rebalance_rule: At new signal or exit only
cost_status: after_30bps_round_trip_transaction_cost_equivalent; excludes dividends, short borrow and exchange lots
selection: Rank all variants by early months, check every variant against current trailing-12m paper threshold and user >20% target. Compare selected combination to fixed parent on identical stock/timeframe pairs. Do not alter existing virtual accounts on this seen history.
limitations: Late history already viewed during selection of both parent experiments.
Adding OBV is a new tested hypothesis, not an author-backed profitability claim.
Corporate events and short borrow remain incomplete.
